headline: This law requires the VA's patient advocacy office to build an online system where veterans can file health care complaints and check their status.
what_it_does: The law directs the Office of Patient Advocacy within the Veterans Health Administration to create an information technology system. The system lets veterans or their representatives file a complaint with a patient advocate electronically. It also lets them review the status of a complaint they have already filed.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive health care through the Veterans Health Administration
who_it_affects.how: They can file patient complaints online and check on how those complaints are progressing.
People authorized to act for a veteran can file complaints and track their status electronically on the veteran's behalf.

who_it_affects.group: Staff in the VA Office of Patient Advocacy
who_it_affects.how: They must set up and maintain the electronic complaint system and the status-tracking feature.
